data.name: Vita Spray
data.description: A medical item that continuously restores health during use. Can be used on yourself or your allies.
data.article:
The Vita Spray is a medical item that continuously restores health. You can use it on yourself or your allies to regain health over time during raids.

You can find this item by scavenging in the environment. It can also be crafted at a Medical Lab once you have learned the Vita Spray Blueprint. It can be recycled for various resources.

data.article: The Vita Spray Blueprint is a blueprint used at the Medical Lab to craft Vita Spray. This medical item continuously restores health when used, either on yourself or an ally.

arc.name: ARC Surveyor
arc.description: This is the largest of the rolling ARCs, a massive, spherical construct designed to dominate open ground. Its primary tactic is to stop periodically on the battlefield to transmit disruptive signals, acting as a massive relay for the ARC network. Be warned, however, its most unique (and dangerous) trait is its resilience: as it takes damage, its outer shell breaks apart into many smaller, armored pieces. Its final attack is a relentless one: it will roll directly at high speed toward any Raider it detects, essentially turning itself into a giant, high-impact bowling ball.

data.name: Voltage Converter
data.description: Used in crafting.
data.article:
The Voltage Converter is a material used in crafting. You can use it at a gear bench to create certain gear, and at an explosives station to create certain explosives. It can also be recycled into other useful resources.

You can find this item by scavenging in the environment. It is also available for purchase from Celeste for 10 coins, with a daily limit of 5. Another way to get it is by recycling or salvaging other items.

data.name: Vulcano Blueprint
data.description: Allows you to craft the Vulcano.
data.article: The Vulcano Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft at the Refiner. You can find it by searching various containers during the Hidden Bunker map condition and by searching First Wave Caches during Hurricane map condition. Another rare blueprint you might find is the Tempest Blueprint.

data.name: Vulcano I
data.description: Has good bullet spread but sharp falloff.
data.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
data.article: The Vulcano I is a semi-automatic shotgun that uses shotgun ammo. This weapon is well-suited for close-range combat due to its wide bullet spread, though its effectiveness drops off quickly at longer distances. Raiders craft it at a Gunsmith, provided they have learned the Vulcano Blueprint. It serves as a base for crafting more advanced versions, such as the Vulcano II.

data.article:
The Vulcano II is a semi-automatic shotgun, representing an upgraded version of the Vulcano I. This weapon improves upon its predecessor by offering an increased fire rate, reduced reload time, and better durability for enhanced combat performance.

You can obtain this item by crafting it at the Gunsmith, upgrading a Vulcano I using various components. It can also be recycled to gain various resources.

data.name: Wasp Driver
data.description: Can be recycled into ARC Alloy.
data.article:
The Wasp Driver is a throwable item that explodes if it is shot after being thrown, dealing damage to nearby ARCs and Raiders.

Raiders obtain this item by defeating Wasps, Wasp Husks, and Couriers.

This item is used in crafting projects and is needed for the The Trifecta quest. Additionally, it can be recycled for resources or salvaged for materials.

arc.name: Wasp
arc.description: This is the Wasp, a baseline enemy drone that poses a threat through sheer numbers. It is a small, unarmored flyer that peppers Raiders with light-caliber ammunition. You'll almost never encounter a Wasp alone; they operate in tight patrols alongside other Wasps or as escorts for their more dangerous counterpart, the Hornet. The moment it turns aggressive, look for a small red laser to lock onto you for one second—that's your cue to dodge before it unleashes a quick 1.5-second burst of gunfire.

data.name: Water Filter
data.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article:
The Water Filter is a component that can be recycled into crafting materials, providing basic components for other items.

You can find this item by scavenging inside metal crates, commonly located in industrial areas:

  • Look in the west tunnels of the Research and Administration area, and also within the Power Generation Complex, both in the Dam Battlegrounds map.
  • Search the Shipping Warehouse in the Spaceport map.

data.article: The Water Pump is a rare item that Raiders can recycle for crafting materials and coins. It is also needed for the Unexpected Initiative quest. Specific areas to check include the Research and Administration west tunnels and Power Generation Complex in the Dam, and the Shipping Warehouse in the Spaceport.

data.name: "Wind Sprite" Ship Model
data.description: Undaunted in the face of its larger brethren, this nimble one-master has been known to brave even the most just-above-average of waves.
data.article:
The "Wind Sprite" Ship Model is a common trinket that can be used to decorate your Raider Den. Finding and extracting with this model also provides bonus Merits, which help you progress along the Miniature Voyages reward track during the Last Resort event.

You can obtain the "Wind Sprite" Ship Model by finding it as a loose item on furniture and inside residential containers. It commonly appears in the Hotel area on the Riven Tides map, and can also be found on other maps like the Buried City and Blue Gate.

data.name: Wires
data.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.article:
Wires are primarily used to craft various mod components. They are also needed to complete the After Rain Comes and Eyes On The Prize quests, as well as for the Expedition project.

You can find them by searching electrical and technological objects in the environment. They can also be obtained by recycling salvage or purchased from Celeste.

data.name: Wolfpack
data.description: A grenade that scatters into multiple homing missiles, each one targeting ARC and dealing explosive damage on impact.
data.article:
The Wolfpack is an explosive item that, when thrown, scatters into 12 homing missiles. These missiles automatically target nearby ARCs, exploding on impact to deal damage. It is particularly effective for dealing with larger ARCs and is considered a more powerful version of the Seeker Grenade.

Raiders craft this item at an Explosives Station after acquiring the Wolfpack Blueprint.

data.name: Wolfpack Blueprint
data.description: Lets you craft a Wolfpack
data.article:
The Wolfpack Blueprint is a blueprint used at an Explosives Station to craft the Wolfpack grenade.

Once deployed, this grenade scatters into 12 individual homing missiles that quickly seek out and explode on impact with nearby ARCs. It is particularly effective for dealing significant damage to larger ARCs like the Rocketeer, Bastion, Bombardier, and Leaper.
